target_customer: Sports fans and the professional athletes they follow
problem: Fans wanted direct, unfiltered access to athletes; Closer Sports offered a mobile live streaming platform connecting athletes to fans.
business_model: Consumer live streaming platform, monetization not stated in sources
product_category: Mobile live streaming, athlete fan engagement

founders.name: Gopal Ramachandran
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; founder profile page was not available.

founders.name: Jeffrey Warren
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; founder profile page was not available.

exit.reason: Cause not public; YC lists the company as Inactive and the closersports.com domain is parked for sale.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile live video streaming at scale needs real engineering, though third party streaming services existed; the larger challenge was recruiting athletes.

defensibility.rationale: Athletes could use Instagram or Twitter live at no cost, and the company showed no exclusive athlete contracts.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Social platforms already offered live video to athletes; no source shows them copying or buying Closer Sports.

market_need_then: Athletes were already streaming on social platforms by 2018, but no Closer Sports specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Used closersports.com, which now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page (checked 2026-11).

brand_strength.rationale: No press, app store listing or community material about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Closer Sports was a two person San Francisco team in YC Winter 2018 building a mobile streaming platform for athletes and fans. Almost no public record exists beyond directory listings, so the cause of its becoming inactive is not public and failure factors are left empty. Free live video on large social networks was the obvious substitute.
notes: The pre seed round rests on a single directory (Employbl), with the amount and investors hidden behind a sign in. Competitor list is empty because the dated competitor search found only unrelated apps, none dated near the 2018 batch. Founding year 2018 comes from the same directory. A design contest page mentioned name variants C2P and Closer 2 Pro but is unconfirmed as this company and was not used. Company website is dead (domain for sale).
